handoff.name: SBAR
handoff.intro: Write the cath-lab-to-CCU/ward handoff using SBAR. Terse and factual; no invented pressures, gradients or angiographic findings. This is a percutaneous procedure — there is no 'incision', use 'access site'.

sections.label: S — Situation
sections.guidance: patient, procedure performed (diagnostic vs PCI, vessels treated), current status

sections.label: B — Background
sections.guidance: indication, access site and closure method, sheath size, contrast volume, anticoagulation / antiplatelet given, devices/stents deployed, any hemodynamic events, blood loss

sections.label: A — Assessment
sections.guidance: stable / for close observation / unstable; access-site status; main concerns

sections.label: R — Recommendation
sections.guidance: access-site checks, distal pulse and neurovascular checks, bed rest duration, antiplatelet plan, when to escalate — as if/then; end with a blank line 'Receiving nurse read-back:'

family.closing_line: The cardiologist will come speak with you directly.
family.notes: This was a procedure through a small tube in an artery, not open surgery — say so plainly. Mention the patient needs to lie still for a while so the puncture site heals. Say where they go next (heart monitoring unit / ward).
